message.content: {"alternatives":[],"likely_cause":{"claim":"The latency increase was caused by degraded cache performance and prolonged index rebuilding.","evidence_ids":["log:1","log:5","log:6","log:3","log:7"]},"missing_evidence":[],"observations":[{"claim":"Cache-fleet node cache-07 experienced a high eviction rate of 412000 keys in 60 seconds, which is above baseline, indicating cache pressure or memory issues.","evidence_ids":["log:1"]},{"claim":"Cache-fleet node cache-07 hit ratio dropped to 0.31 from a baseline of 0.94, indicating poor cache hit performance during the window.","evidence_ids":["log:5"]},{"claim":"Index-builder was running a segment rebuild for shard 7 that lasted 18 minutes, exceeding the expected 6 minutes, indicating a delay in index maintenance.","evidence_ids":["log:6"]},{"claim":"Search-gateway p95 response time increased to 1840ms and later to 2110ms, compared to a baseline of 610ms, showing a significant latency increase during the window.","evidence_ids":["log:3","log:7"]},{"claim":"Search-gateway reported a telemetry backend 503 error when reading latency metrics, indicating possible monitoring or telemetry issues during the latency spike.","evidence_ids":["log:8"]}],"outcome":"supported","suggested_checks":["Check cache-fleet memory and eviction policies for node cache-07.","Investigate reasons for prolonged index rebuild on shard 7 in index-builder.","Review search-gateway telemetry backend availability and error handling."]}
